NaMiniApp__UiText.NaMiniApp__NoticeBody: This page does not download photographs. It copies a JavaScript snippet to your clipboard so you can paste it into the browser console on a house-buying website. That is for listing pages whose image carousel blocks right-click save, so you cannot grab every photo in one go.

NaMiniApp__UiText.NaMiniApp__SnippetAriaLabel: Homeflow carousel image downloader console snippet

NaMiniApp__Steps: Click Copy snippet to clipboard on this page.
Open the property listing in another tab. This snippet is written for Homeflow-powered UK estate-agent sites.
Press F12, open the Console tab, paste the snippet, and press Enter.
The browser downloads each carousel image in order, named 01__original-filename, 02__original-filename, and so on.
NaMiniApp__Notes: Paste the snippet on the listing page. Pasting it here, or on a site that is not Homeflow, will fail.
It reads Homeflow.get('property').photos — the carousel data already on Homeflow agent websites.
Protocol-relative URLs (//mr1…) are turned into https:// before download.
Each image is requested at the 1920px variant (/1920x_/) rather than the small carousel thumbnail.
There is a 400ms pause between files so Chrome is less likely to block the batch.
Allow multiple downloads if the browser asks. Failed files are logged in the console; the loop continues.
